body:
Dear all,

The proposal has been made to obsolete **GO:0061753 substrate localization to autophagosome**.
See parent ontology ticket: https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32304

This ticket transfers the per-annotation transfer recommendations produced in that issue (see [this comment](https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32304#issuecomment-5223734475)). Each recommendation below is grounded solely in the single PMID cited on the original annotation, per @raymond91125's request. IEAs are out of scope — they will propagate automatically once the direct annotations are moved and once the MF adaptor classes (`GO:0140580`, `GO:0140506`, etc.) are re-parented as part of the obsoletion (see `geneontology/go-ontology#31866`).

QuickGO counts at time of review: 5 direct experimental annotations to `GO:0061753`, plus 5 experimental MF annotations that reference `GO:0061753` in an annotation extension.

## Impacted groups

Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv

| Group | Annotations to review | 
|---|---|---|
| UniProt | 5 (TOM1 direct; IRGQ direct; two IRGQ MF-extension) |---|
| MGI | 3 (Stbd1 direct ×2; Stbd1 MF-extension ×2) |---|
| ParkinsonsUK-UCL | 1 (SMURF1 direct) | done | 
| GO Central / mouse | 1 (Gabarapl1 MF-extension) |---|

## (A) Direct experimental annotations to GO:0061753

| # | Gene product | Assigned by | Ev | PMID | Current extension | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | UniProtKB:O60784 **TOM1** (human) | UniProt | IMP | PMID:23023224 | — | Move to **GO:0061909 autophagosome-lysosome fusion** (primary phenotype in the paper is a fusion block; myosin VI/TOM1 axis). Optionally add **GO:0035973 aggrephagy** since huntingtin-aggregate clearance was one of the assayed cargos. |
| 2 | UniProtKB:Q8C7E7 **Stbd1** (mouse) | MGI | IMP | PMID:20810658 | `part_of` GO:0061723 | Move BP term to **GO:0061723 glycophagy**. Paper is the founding "glycophagy" description via Stbd1-AIM-GABARAPL1. The redundant extension is then removed. |
| 3 | UniProtKB:Q8C7E7 **Stbd1** (mouse) | MGI | IMP | PMID:27358407 | — | Move to **GO:0061723 glycophagy**. Paper (Stbd1/GAA double KO) demonstrates Stbd1's dominant role in glycogen transport to lysosomes in liver. |
| 4 | UniProtKB:Q8WZA9 **IRGQ** (human) | UniProt | IDA | PMID:39481378 | — | Not glycophagy/mitophagy/reticulophagy. Paper shows IRGQ routes misfolded MHC-I to lysosomal degradation via GABARAPL2/LC3B. Best current fits: **GO:0006515 protein quality control for misfolded or incompletely synthesized proteins** together with **GO:0016236 macroautophagy** (or its child if a more specific term exists locally). No dedicated "MHC-I selective autophagy" term exists in GO — worth a follow-up new-term request if PomBase/UniProt curators want a more specific class. |
| 5 | UniProtKB:Q9HCE7 **SMURF1** (human) | ParkinsonsUK-UCL | IMP | PMID:22020285 | `has_target_start_location` GO:0005739; `part_of` GO:0061734 | Move to **GO:0061734 type 2 mitophagy** (Parkin-mediated mitophagy is the assayed phenotype; term already in extension). The same PMID also documents a role in viral autophagy, so a second annotation to **GO:0098792 xenophagy** is warranted from the same evidence. |

## (B) Experimental MF annotations that carry GO:0061753 in an extension

These are MF annotations whose `part_of` extension currently points at GO:0061753. In every case the same paper supports a more specific selective-autophagy BP that already exists in GO — the extension should be swapped, not just dropped.

| # | Gene product | MF term | PMID | Current extension | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | UniProtKB:Q8C7E7 **Stbd1** (mouse) | GO:0038024 cargo receptor activity | PMID:20810658 | `part_of` GO:0061723, `part_of` GO:0061753, `has_input` CHEBI:28087, `directly_positively_regulates` GO:0043495 | Drop `part_of GO:0061753`; keep `part_of GO:0061723 glycophagy`. |
| 2 | UniProtKB:Q8C7E7 **Stbd1** (mouse) | GO:0038024 cargo receptor activity | PMID:27358407 | `part_of` GO:0061753, `has_input` CHEBI:28087 | Replace `part_of GO:0061753` → **`part_of GO:0061723` glycophagy**. |
| 3 | UniProtKB:Q8R3R8 **Gabarapl1** (mouse) | GO:0043495 protein-membrane adaptor activity | PMID:21893048 | `part_of` GO:0061753 | Replace `part_of GO:0061753` → **`part_of GO:0061723` glycophagy** (paper is the Stbd1-AIM-GABARAPL1 study defining glycophagy). |
| 4 | UniProtKB:Q8WZA9 **IRGQ** (human) | GO:0030674 protein-macromolecule adaptor activity | PMID:39481378 | includes `part_of` GO:0006515 and `part_of` GO:0061753 | Drop `part_of GO:0061753` — `part_of GO:0006515` already carries the biological context this PMID actually supports. |
| 5 | UniProtKB:Q8WZA9 **IRGQ** (human) | GO:0030674 protein-macromolecule adaptor activity | PMID:39481378 | as #4 with different `has_input` UniProt id | Same as #4. |

## Mappings that need to be reviewed (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule)

None known to map directly to `GO:0061753` at the time of this review. The upstream MF classes that are `part_of GO:0160247` (which sits over `GO:0061753`) — e.g. `GO:0140580` mitochondrion autophagosome adaptor activity, `GO:0140506` endoplasmic reticulum-autophagosome adaptor activity — will need to be re-parented as part of the obsoletion so their IEA propagations land on the correct selective-autophagy BP. That is tracked in `geneontology/go-ontology#31866` rather than here.

## Notes / caveats

- The IRGQ case (rows A4 / B4-5) is the only one where GO does not yet have a dedicated selective-autophagy child (MHC-I quality-control autophagy). Worth spinning out a term request if that cargo-receptor class is going to grow.
- A curator-facing spreadsheet was not generated as part of this review — recommendations are inline above and cover the full experimental set from QuickGO. Happy to transcribe into the standard [Annotation Review template](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1izV3q1jnq_Ybg5MJ53O_b5BCTkGtjl_Fi-cOg3-7eBE/edit#gid=0) if that would help downstream tracking.

Thanks.
